_doc: Planner arms for run_benchmark.py. scenario_overrides: dotted keys set on each scenario before planning (null removes). TIGRIS arms start from the stack tuning (stacks/tigris_search/config/tigris_search_planner.yaml) and apply tigris_set on top; planning_time 1000 s + commit_margin -992 keeps the flown 8 s commit distance while max_iterations bounds each solve, so runs are deterministic and do not depend on machine load. On the robot a 5 s solve ran about 500-700 iterations.
